final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.observstation, o.weathprofile, COUNT(*) as group_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile), step2 AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(CAST(group_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_count FROM step1 GROUP BY weathprofile), joined AS (SELECT s1.observstation, s1.weathprofile, s1.group_count, s1.group_count - s2.avg_count as diff FROM step1 s1 JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.weathprofile = s2.weathprofile WHERE s1.group_count > s2.avg_count) SELECT observstation, weathprofile, group_count, diff FROM joined ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
